name_en: Beijing Dahua Tiantan Garment Co., Ltd.
name_cn: 北京大华天坛服装有限公司
main_products: Men's shirts and suits, high-end custom tailoring (TIANTAN, PURE TOUCH brands)
woven_evidence: It grew out of the former Beijing Dahua Shirt Factory (founded 1954), has dress shirt and suit workshops, and helped draft the national shirt-size standard.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The Beijing commerce bureau's 138th fair exhibitor list includes 北京大华天坛服装有限公司 in Phase 3, Men's & Women's Wear, with 1 general booth. The list classifies it as a production enterprise (生产企业).

notes: It is a subsidiary of Beijing Dahua Fashion Technology (北京大华时尚科技发展有限公司). The company says it has a 45,000 m2 industrial park with shirt and suit workshops (self-reported). Published contacts: bg@dahuafashion.com, 010-82631160.
